verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic-search runtime and cloud service, so scheduled jobs such as recurring re-crawls or index syncs are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only one-off actions: crawling a web source, upserting documents, and hot-swap freshness on load. Nothing shows a recurring schedule, cron trigger, or workflow scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
